# Operational templates

These are human-facing review and operations templates. They are not scaffold implementation sources; generated application templates remain under [`../../scaffold/templates/`](../../scaffold/templates/).

- [Installation checklist](installation-checklist.md) — collect evidence that an application implements the deployment contract.
- [Configuration matrix](configuration-matrix.md) — record configuration ownership, sensitivity, timing, scope, and cross-service invariants.

The repository currently has no separate infrastructure-request template; use the [virtual-machine request guide](../guides/requesting-a-virtual-machine.md).
